scores_role: Descriptive single unblinded manual-review scores under the shared rubric; not a preregistered superiority metric and not a measured noise floor.
usage_counter_semantics: Totals sum CLI-reported per-call usage counters. Whether resume counters are cumulative is not established; no distinct billed consumption or efficiency claim.

readability_observation.qualification: Single unblinded samples; no measured noise floor and no causal conclusion.
